description: Carbon offset projects registered with the Climate Action Reserve (CAR, the North American voluntary and California compliance registry) from its public APX project report: project ID, name, developer/owner, verifier, project type, status, compliance (ARB/WA ECO) status, location, offset credits registered, listed and registered dates, SDG tags. Filter by type, status, state, country or text; sorted by credits. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Project site country code, e.g. US, MX

query.description: Text in project ID, name, developer or owner

status.description: Status, e.g. Registered, Listed, Completed, Transitioned

type.description: Project type contains, e.g. Forest, Landfill, Livestock, Nitric Acid, Ozone Depleting
